major_cooldowns.name: Summon Darkglare
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your main cooldown: enter it with a pandemic-extended Agony so no global is wasted refreshing dots, then spend Unstable Affliction and channel Malefic Grasp for the whole window, emptying your shards before the last 8 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Harvest
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown with Agony, Corruption or Unstable Affliction ticking, drop to 2 or fewer Soul Shards first as Soul Harvester so the Succulent Souls do not overcap, and line it up immediately before Summon Darkglare.

major_cooldowns.name: Malevolence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hellcaller only: press it on cooldown and sync it with Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest, dumping Unstable Affliction inside the 20 second window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 442726 is the castable 1 min cooldown row; 430014 is the talent node and 446285 the 100 yd variant. Not pressed in the sampled Soul Harvester parse.

defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a telegraphed magic hit or a heavy damage window for 25% reduction, and use it to cast through interrupts, silences and pushback.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Trade 20% of your current health for a much larger 20 second shield, pressed at high health ahead of predictable damage and usable while controlled.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency 20% maximum health heal that also horrifies the target for 3 seconds, so spend it on an add you can afford to send running.

rules.description: Agony stays up on every target
rules.action: Never let Agony drop: it is your only Soul Shard generator and it ramps from zero. Refresh inside the pandemic window at under 5.4 seconds remaining, 4.5 seconds with Creeping Death, and hold it on up to 5 targets in AoE.

rules.description: Agony refreshed inside its pandemic window
rules.action: Refresh Agony at under 5.4 seconds remaining, 4.5 with Creeping Death: an early refresh throws the leftover duration away and costs a global you owe Malefic Grasp. The one deliberate exception is topping Agony up immediately before Summon Darkglare so nothing needs refreshing inside the window.

rules.description: Malefic Grasp fills the Summon Darkglare window
rules.action: Channel Malefic Grasp, not Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt, for every global of the 20 second Darkglare window that is not an Unstable Affliction, and keep the most recent Unstable Affliction ticking so it is still up to be hit. Break the channel early only for a Nightfall proc.

rules.description: Cascading Calamity kept up by Unstable Affliction
rules.action: Cast Unstable Affliction on a target that already has it before the 15 second haste buff expires, and only dump the rest of your shards inside Summon Darkglare or Malevolence.

rules.description: Dark Harvest after dumping Soul Shards
rules.action: Spend down to 2 or fewer Soul Shards with Unstable Affliction before channeling Dark Harvest, otherwise the shards it generates are wasted. Then enter Summon Darkglare on the shards it just gave you.
Channel Dark Harvest first, then summon the Darkglare, so the 3 second channel does not eat globals inside the 20 second amplification window.

rules.description: Haunt and dots before Dark Harvest and Darkglare
rules.action: Pre-cast Haunt, apply Agony and your second dot, cast Unstable Affliction down to 2 Soul Shards, then Dark Harvest into Summon Darkglare with trinkets and racials.

rules.description: Seed of Corruption on stacked targets
rules.action: From 3 stacked targets, 2 as Soul Harvester, apply and maintain Corruption or Wither with Seed of Corruption instead of hard-casting it, and fire it at 5 Soul Shards or above 2 shards just before Dark Harvest comes up.
As Hellcaller, line Malevolence up with Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest rather than pressing it in isolation, and spend Unstable Affliction inside both windows.

source_summary: Affliction's output is built on never dropping Agony and stacking every shard spender into Summon Darkglare, the 2 minute amplification window entered with a pandemic-extended Agony so no global is lost refreshing dots. Dark Harvest is channeled on cooldown at 2 or fewer Soul Shards and lined up immediately before the Darkglare summon, with Malevolence synced to the same window on Hellcaller builds. Everything else is maintenance: keep Cascading Calamity rolling with Unstable Affliction, swap to Seed of Corruption once targets stack, and dump the shard bank before the Darkglare window ends.
